decision_conditions:
SOLAR PANELS (DETAILS): Notwithstanding the approved drawings, full details of the proposed solar photovoltaic (PV) panels, associated battery storage unit, and all cabling routes shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to installation. The submitted details shall 
include: 

• the size, profile, finish, and precise fixing method of the PV panels; 
• the exact location, appearance, ventilation, and mounting of the 
battery storage unit; 
• the full routing, containment, and external appearance of all cabling and connections, ensuring they are concealed or discreetly located to avoid visual harm. 
The works shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details. The PV panels shall not project above the ridge line or beyond the roof plane, and all cabling shall be installed so as to minimise visibility from the public realm. The development shall thereafter be retained as installed. 

REASON: To ensure that the visual appearance of the installation—including panels, battery storage, and cabling—preserves the architectural and historic character of the building and the wider conservation area.
description: Replacement of existing front windows with new sash windows. Installation of PV panels to roof.  [Full plan application: P2025/2739/FUL also submitted].
